items.title: Bill Holman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: he brought them out here and asked Roger Gorman if he could make a film around this footage... So that was the only instruction I got.

ctx.x: Well what kind of instructions did you get with a film like that? What do they give to you?

Well how this first film came together was a theater, a guy in the south had owned a string of theaters and had a bunch of color footage of the Florida everglades, real nice pictures. And he brought them out here and asked Roger Gorman if he could make a film around this footage, you know, get a story written and everything, just so this guy could use it. And it did. It was about a gang of girl jewel thieves that had escaped from prison and go back to reclaim their swag, their buried treasure. And they had to go…
Can you recall what you got paid for that?
